_what: Pre-registered answer key for the B experiment (one-context blind sheet readers vs the historical derivation path). Written BEFORE any reader ran, from the three committed stroke-level ink reads. Readers never see this file; their prompts forbid leaving the bundle dir.

_scoring_bands_mm.note: LLM visual estimation at these zooms is ~3.8 mm/px (7x) so <20 mm agreement is luck, not skill; the experiment's real question is CLASS errors (missed elements, wrong direction, label-vs-drawn not caught), mirroring the lane's historical failures. A reader returning an ink value to 0.1 mm precision is a contamination tell, not a win.

historical_baseline.what: The derivation-path first-pass this experiment is benchmarked against (R12's own record).
